patch_application.working_baseline: Unmodified CRLF native top plus the unchanged pinned common-src wrapper; native F500 uses shared project files, so its small candidate directory alone is not a complete baseline tree.

core_comparison.scope: Named gen_pcspma subset: primitive type/LOC/BEL and net ROUTE/pin hashes. Excludes explicitly named shared constants and shared/global ROUTE strings over100000characters, external reset nets, clocks outside this hierarchy, and analog behavior. Signature SHA256 covers canonical compared CELL/NET records only; not complete image equivalence.
core_comparison.manual_review: All five changed common net names are PCS/PMA reset aliases; the five names unique to each build are reset-output aliases in the core reset and TX elastic-buffer reset modules. This bounded subset does not establish full image equivalence.
